text:
aj_support: heads-up — we have a priority activation stall for customer BetaFoods (TKT-4579). Trial tenant failing SSO provisioning with 403 on token exchange. Trial expires in 5 days, onboarding call scheduled tomorrow 10am PT. Need CS to own customer comms and coordinate an immediate workaround + timeline. @maria_cs @kevin_reeng @sara_enablement

SupportBot: Ticket TKT-4579 created and linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TKT-4579 (priority: high) :rotating_light:

maria_cs: on it. quick questions — has support reproduced the 403 from our side, or is it intermittent on the customer's side? also which IdP (vendor) are they on?

aj_support: reproduced from our staging with their tenant. IdP is Okta (SAML). Steps we ran: restart provisioner, regen service key, attempted token refresh. same 403 returned. snippet of response below:

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "invalid_grant",
  "error_description": "SAML assertion not accepted by IdP for audience\n"
}
```

aj_support: also seeing this in prod logs when customer flows through the hosted onboarding screen, so it's blocking activation. I've added last successful provisioning timestamp in the ticket.

kevin_reeng: thanks. quick thought — could be an audience mismatch or clock skew on the SP metadata. ask customer to verify SP entityID and clock skew < 5m. temporary fallback: enable OAuth fallback on their tenant (we can toggle) to let them finish onboarding while we debug SAML. will need CS to get customer permission for the toggle.

maria_cs: perfect. here's a suggested comms plan I propose we follow now:
- immediate customer note (by CS): acknowledge, explain impact, provide ETA for workaround (2–4 hrs) and full fix timeline (24–48 hrs)
- schedule a 30-min jitter-free troubleshooting call today with their admin + our infra eng (kevin) — propose 2pm PT
- offer OAuth fallback as a stopgap and get opt-in written in thread
- follow up with a post-mortem + steps we took before trial ends

maria_cs: draft email copy (short):
"Hi Amy — we see your SSO provisioning failing due to a token exchange issue. We can enable a temporary OAuth fallback to get you activated right away and then work with your IdP (Okta) on a permanent fix. Proposed call today 2pm PT. Please reply with OK to proceed with fallback or confirm availability for the call"

sara_enablement: I can spin up a short runbook for the call checklist and provide the quick command snippets for the OAuth toggle. ETA 45m.

aj_support: thanks all — I toggled debug logs and linked the latest stacktrace in the ticket. Calling out renewals: account shows trial-to-paid intent, renewal risk high if we miss activation window. tagging for CS priority.

maria_cs: action items summary — assigning owners:
- send customer note + get consent for OAuth fallback (owner: maria_cs) — due in 30m
- enable OAuth fallback if consent given (owner: kevin_reeng) — due in 2h
- prep troubleshooting call runbook and signal docs (owner: sara_enablement) — due in 45m
- update TKT-4579 with comms and next steps (owner: aj_support) — ongoing

maria_cs: I'll post the confirmation here once I get Amy's reply. please react with :thumbsup: when you see the message so I know folks are aligned.

kevin_reeng: :thumbsup: on standby for the toggle.

sara_enablement: :thumbsup: will add runbook to ticket.

aj_support: noted and will keep the ticket updated. back to monitoring logs.

maria_cs: received initial ack from Amy: "OK to proceed with OAuth fallback and call today at 2pm PT." scheduling invite sent. assigning follow-ups in TKT-4579. thanks team — will loop back after call. :white_check_mark:
